# Release v3.4.5

## 🐛 Bug Fixes

- **drift:** report a project's own jobs instead of counting them as drift (#494)

  `cidx check drift` compares a workflow job with the pipeline only when its
  name denotes a phase. Any other job — a scan or check the project runs on its
  own — is listed under "Jobs not managed by cidx" and no longer fails the
  command. A job named like a phase the pipeline does not declare is still
  drift.
